modalities.evidence: low-dose whole body CT images and tissue segmentations
underwent PET/CT imaging on the uEXPLORER total-body PET/CT system
age, gender, weight, height, and body mass index are also provided

output.population: Thirty healthy adult research participants, 18 years of age or older, able to provide informed written consent
output.summary: Low-dose whole-body CT images with automatically generated tissue segmentations from healthy adults imaged on a total-body PET/CT system at multiple timepoints after tracer injection, plus basic demographic and body measurements.
